transcript.statement: The responsibilities of the library management system are paramount to ensure ethical compliance and accountability. RES-01 ensures data protection regulations are met through encryption, while RES-02 provides accessibility for all users, promoting fairness. RES-03 logs user actions for accountability, and RES-04 maintains borrowing policies to ensure responsible resource management. RES-05 reinforces member accountability through timely overdue notifications. RES-06 invites member feedback for continuous improvement, and RES-07 ensures transparency by reporting usage statistics. These requirements are essential for a trustworthy system.

transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the library management system. TRU-01 ensures that only authenticated members can access borrowing functions, protecting user data. TRU-02 logs borrowing transactions for auditability, maintaining accountability. TRU-03 enforces data encryption to safeguard personal information, while TRU-04 implements role-based access control to restrict access based on user roles. TRU-05 provides a secure mechanism for managing overdue books, TRU-06 allows secure updates of personal information, and TRU-07 mandates strong password policies for enhanced security. These requirements collectively ensure a trustworthy system that prioritizes user privacy and data integrity.

transcript.statement: The Safety & Reliability of the library management system is critical to ensure that members can borrow and return books without risks. SAF-01 enforces a maximum borrowing limit to mitigate risks of overextension. SAF-02 ensures timely notifications for overdue books, enhancing accountability and encouraging responsible borrowing. SAF-03 maintains real-time inventory status to prevent double borrowing, ensuring reliability. SAF-04 provides a backup mechanism for data recovery, essential for fault tolerance. SAF-05 allows librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for those with overdue books, promoting accountability. SAF-06 ensures that only registered members can access borrowing features, and SAF-07 logs transactions for audit purposes. These requirements collectively enhance safety and reliability.

transcript.statement: The sustainability of the library management system is essential to minimize its environmental impact. GRN-01 ensures energy-efficient operations by using sustainable infrastructure, while GRN-02 provides a quarterly energy usage report to track improvements. GRN-03 promotes digital notifications to reduce paper waste, and GRN-04 allows members to understand the carbon footprint of each book, fostering awareness. GRN-05 implements a recycling program, ensuring damaged books are disposed of responsibly. GRN-06 tracks energy savings from digital operations, and GRN-07 prioritizes e-books to reduce physical resource consumption. Each requirement contributes to a sustainable library system that aligns with environmental values.

EFF-05 and EFF-06 focus on timely notifications and quick librarian operations, both vital for operational efficiency. EFF-07 guarantees high system uptime, maintaining consistent availability for users. These requirements collectively enhance performance efficiency and user satisfaction.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations through encryption and secure handling of personal information.
The system shall provide a mechanism for timely notifications of overdue books and allow members to manage their accounts securely.
The system shall maintain an accurate inventory status and enforce a maximum borrowing limit to ensure resource management.
The system shall support energy-efficient operations while ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
The system shall provide robust authentication and access control mechanisms for all users.
The system shall enable real-time updates and tracking of book availability to enhance operational efficiency.
The system shall log all transactions for audit and accountability purposes.
The system shall implement a digital notification system to reduce paper waste and promote sustainability.
